bed_route_adapter.route_source: typed DirectSpeakers bed route with physical row identity and bed_id

derived_fields.meaning: unmuted/enable polarity for the selected model

derived_fields.source: explicit bed-branch assignment, not raw record bytes

bed_route_adapter.interpretation: The frozen adapter explicitly creates width zero for the bed branch. It is not a width decoded from bytes 24..51 and not an F01E-authored bed width field.

regular_audio_fields.semantic: uniform_width after F01E.8 event-width normalization and sampler; not the raw authored width

object_route_adapter.feature_domain_guard: Do not map event audio-diffuse word10 or a same-named post-F04 field into F03R feature_diffuse.

f03r_consumption.approved_input_domain: physical control rows0..37 with bed/object role, direct-LFE classification, mute, finite F32 width, and separate selected feature component/diffuse controls
f03r_consumption.direct_lfe: the sole bed_id3 row is removed from regular tail processing
f03r_consumption.regular_rows: the other 37 physical rows are processed in physical order and map to source11..47
f03r_consumption.mute_use: mute is passed to the activity/window consumer and becomes reset_flag
f03r_consumption.width_use: the selected frozen SourceFlags helper reads width for every mapped tail; if unmuted and active, width>=R32(0.2) triggers the width exclusion. There is no bed-specific width skip in this helper.
f03r_consumption.bed_width_result: frozen bed width0 is consumed and does not trigger the >=0.2 exclusion
f03r_consumption.feature_use: component_enum and feature_diffuse must be0 in the selected branch; other values reject

typed_clean_adapter.recommendation: Use a tagged BedRegularControl and ObjectRegularControl source adapter, then project each into the selected F03R RegularControl fields. Keep SelectedFeatureControl as a separate typed input.
typed_clean_adapter.bed_variant: host_channel_index, bed_id, mute=false from defined route prefix, width=F32 positive zero from explicit frozen bed-branch assignment; no 52-byte bed tail
typed_clean_adapter.object_variant: host_channel_index, mute from F01E word0, width from F01E word9 uniform_width
typed_clean_adapter.selected_feature_variant: component_enum=0 and feature_diffuse=0 from selected-profile adapter; not copied from audio diffuse metadata
